Adapter statics: input arrangement striped, output indices, temp storage 1 to 1 bytes.

algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): latency not_guaranteed wins 1 of 38 cells (runner-up in 2), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 1 of 35 cells (runner-up in 2), throughput not_guaranteed wins 0 of 38 cells (runner-up in 2), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 0 of 35 cells (runner-up in 1).
Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 128), the median margin over the runner-up is +0 percent and over the scope's reference control +181 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 2048 k 4 +2823 percent behind W2_packed_v3 in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +2333 percent behind W2_packed_v3 in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 2048 k 16 +2160 percent behind W5_v4 in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 2048 k 32 +1480 percent behind W5_v4 in latency prefer_smaller_index.
negative: The GB200 pass measured random input only on one host (gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): the tie_heavy, shuffled-tie and phase 3b order-check findings for this adapter are on its B200 card.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
